title: Business Email Compromise via OAuth App Consent Grant
description: Attacker sends phishing email to CFO, tricks user into granting OAuth permissions to a malicious third-party app that reads all mail and exports to attacker-controlled cloud storage.
attack_narrative: Attacker registered a malicious AAD application named 'DocuSign Pro Helper' impersonating a legitimate e-signature service. A targeted phishing email with a fake DocuSign link directed the CFO to an OAuth consent page. The CFO granted Mail.ReadWrite and Mail.Send permissions. The app immediately began exfiltrating the last 90 days of inbox via Microsoft Graph API, then forwarded copies of future emails using a hidden inbox rule. The attack went undetected for 3 days.

azure_ad_audit.analyst_note: Mail.ReadWrite + Mail.Send granted to unknown third-party app. Legitimate DocuSign does not require mail permissions.
AllPrincipals consent type — if admin consented, would apply tenant-wide. User-level here but scope is overly broad.
Standard User.Read consent for Zoom — expected and low-risk.

m365_audit.analyst_note: Inbox rule created by OAuth app (not user directly): blank rule name, forwards to external Proton address and deletes original — classic BEC exfil rule.
3847 items accessed in first 45 seconds by OAuth app — bulk mail read characteristic of automated exfiltration.
Sent items also exfiltrated — attacker building full communication picture.
Simultaneous legitimate Outlook access — CFO reading email normally while app exfiltrates.

zeek_http.analyst_note: Graph API bulk message fetch with unusual user agent. Non-standard $top=999 indicates automated harvesting.

attack_chain: T1566.002: Spearphishing link to fake DocuSign OAuth consent page
T1528: Steal application access token via malicious OAuth app consent
T1114.002: Email collection via Graph API (3847 inbox + 1203 sent items)
T1567.002: Exfiltration via cloud API channel (Graph + forwarding rule to Proton)
ground_truth.compromised_data: 3 days of CFO email including financial forecasts, M&A discussions, wire transfer authorizations
ground_truth.persistence_mechanism: Hidden inbox forwarding rule survives password reset
indicators_of_compromise: Bulk MailItemsAccessed (>1000 items) by non-Outlook client
containment_steps: Revoke OAuth token for app a3b9c2d1 immediately
Reset CFO credentials and MFA tokens
Review all emails sent from CFO account during 3-day window
Notify legal/compliance of potential PII breach
detection_improvements: Alert on MailItemsAccessed >500 items by non-standard client within 5 minutes
Alert on new inbox rules created by OAuth apps (not user agent = Outlook)
Implement app consent policy requiring admin approval for Mail.ReadWrite
Deploy Conditional Access policy blocking consent from unmanaged devices

criteria: Links consent event to bulk mail access: 15pts
